name: text-jelly-letters
title: Jelly Rubber Band
description: Từng ký tự nhún bẹp rồi dài ra vài nhịp như viên thạch, lan từ trái sang.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Split chars, pivot bottom centre. Each char runs 0.9 s of scaleX/scaleY keys: 0 % (1, 1), 30 % (1.25, 0.75), 40 % (0.75, 1.25), 50 % (1.15, 0.85), 65 % (0.95, 1.05), 75 % (1.05, 0.95), 100 % (1, 1), sine in-out between keys; 60 ms stagger (capped 0.5 s total), from 0.4 s. Chars flash accent while either scale < 0.9. Source trigger: hover (demo cursor arrives 0.02–0.38 s, leaves 2.15–2.6 s). Loop 2.8 s. Params: duration: mỗi ký tự (0.9 s) · stagger (0.06 s) · squash: bẹp đỉnh (1.25 / 0.75).
